description: This Java source file defines the class `NoteCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer`, which is responsible for deserializing JSON input into `NoteCommand` objects within the Fineract project, specifically handling note-related API requests. It also provides validation logic for the note data extracted from JSON.

classes.name: NoteCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: A deserializer class that converts JSON payloads into `NoteCommand` objects and validates note data for the Fineract API.

methods.name: commandFromApiJson
methods.description: Parses JSON input to extract the 'note' field and creates a new `NoteCommand` instance.

methods.name: validateNote
methods.description: Validates the JSON input, ensuring the 'note' field is present, not blank, and does not exceed 1000 characters; throws validation exception if errors are found.
